description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of various emotional categories, likely representing a dataset used in the evaluation of speaker anonymization on emotional speech. The chart is divided into six distinct slices. The largest slice, colored blue-grey, represents "Frustration" at 25.1%. Moving counter-clockwise, the subsequent slices are "Anger" in olive green at 14.9%, "Sadness" in brown at 14.7%, "Excitement" in maroon at 14.1%, and "Happiness" in medium blue at 8.1%. The final slice, located in the top right and colored dark purple, represents the "Neutral" category at 23.1%. The chart does not utilize a separate legend; rather, the category labels are placed outside the pie adjacent to their respective segments, and the exact percentage values are printed directly inside each slice. There are no visually emphasized, exploded, or offset slices. While the segments on the left and bottom appear roughly ordered by descending size in a counter-clockwise direction, the overall chart does not follow a strict size-based sorting due to the placement of the large "Neutral" slice.
